module.name: roksbnkctl Workspace (IBM ROKS + BNK)
module.description: Provision an IBM Cloud ROKS cluster and install BIG-IP Next for Kubernetes (BNK) with roksbnkctl, driven from a BNK Forge blueprint form. Credential-backed via an IBM Cloud credential template (the run receives IBMCLOUD_API_KEY from the project's template).

required.name: prefix
required.description: Resource name prefix for all workspace resources (e.g. acme-eu).

required.name: region
required.description: IBM Cloud region (e.g. eu-de). Inherited from the credential template by default.

required.name: resource_group
required.description: IBM Cloud resource group. Inherited from the credential template by default.

optional.name: cluster_create
optional.description: Provision a NEW ROKS cluster (true) or attach to an EXISTING one (false; cluster_name is its name/ID). Default true.

optional.name: openshift_version
optional.description: OpenShift version for a new ROKS cluster (blank = ROKS default). Ignored for an existing cluster.

optional.name: workers_per_zone
optional.description: Worker nodes per zone for a new cluster (default 2). Ignored for an existing cluster.

optional.name: install_bnk
optional.description: Install BIG-IP Next for Kubernetes (BNK). Default true.

optional.name: testing_vpc
optional.description: Testing phase: external client VPC + Transit Gateway jumphost. Default false.

optional.name: testing_in_cluster
optional.description: Testing phase: in-cluster per-AZ jumphosts. Default false.

optional.name: install_gateway
optional.description: Deploy the gateway phase. Default false.

required.name: ibmcloud
required.description: IBM Cloud API key, supplied by the project's IBM credential template as IBMCLOUD_API_KEY in the run environment.
